classification_rule.P0_P4_BALANCED_IMPROVEMENT: B stock < A stock with face-down <= A+1, or B face-down < A with stock <= A
classification_rule.P0_P4_LOCAL_GAIN_PRESERVED: B ties or improves both endpoints, retains productive workspace descendants, and uses fewer forced services
classification_rule.P2_P7_BALANCED_IMPROVEMENT: B stock < A stock and B face-down <= historical no-workspace face-down
classification_rule.P2_P7_LOCAL_GAIN_PRESERVED: B stock >= A stock, B face-down < historical no-workspace face-down, and B uses fewer forced lag-1 services than A
classification_rule.P2_P7_OVER_SUPPRESSED: B productive workspace descendants <=25% of A and B face-down >= historical no-workspace face-down
classification_rule.P2_P7_STILL_STALLED: B stock is no more than one row better than A after at least one B lag-1 grace service

lease_semantics.consumption: only an actual forced lag-1 expansion permanently spends that integer epoch
lease_semantics.lag0: normally eligible; does not consume grace
lease_semantics.lag1: eligible only when the integer stock epoch has never spent grace
lease_semantics.missed_window: reset N8 counter and continue ordinary search; no catch-up entitlement
lease_semantics.release: release only lane ownership when reserved state becomes ineligible; frontier entry is untouched
lease_semantics.stock_epoch: minimum stock rows among unique live non-stale ordinary frontier entries

verdict_rule.LAG1_GRACE_EFFECTIVE: on both P2 and P7 B improves stock, remains below the historical no-workspace face-down reference, performs forced lag-1 service, and retains productive workspace circulation
verdict_rule.LAG1_GRACE_INERT: B performs no forced lag-1 grace service, or all four paired endpoints and workspace expansion counts equal A
verdict_rule.LAG1_GRACE_STILL_OVERINVESTS: on both P2 and P7 B spends grace but improves stock by at most one row
verdict_rule.LAG1_GRACE_TOO_RESTRICTIVE: on both P2 and P7 B retains <=25% of A productive workspace descendants and loses the historical local advantage
